messages.subject: Shiny Server in Mac/OSX Yosemite
parts:
I have installed Shiny Server in my Mac following the recommendations in: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/wiki/Building-Shiny-Server-from-Source

However, I can not start Shiny Server (error message: /proc/9368/exe doesn't exist--got Linux?) and launch any Shiny app in the web using Shiny Server. In de Welcome to Shiny Server page, that comes in the samples folder in Shiny Server, it says that the Shiny Server is installed, but I can not see the Shiny app example on the right side. 

Is anyone has some advice on how I can get Shiny Server working in my Mac??? Thank you in advance!
